attack_bow.name: attack_bow

beats.note: hauling the head up over the shoulder, base set wide
full overhead load — arched back under the weight, a beat of held threat
the CHOP — over the top and buried low-forward, the family's biggest lunge, root sunk with it

wrenched free and hauled back up over the shoulder — the recovery is work
